== Merge with Roy Bordier (October 2026) ==
* Merged [[Ray Bordier|Roy Bordier]] (2007–2012 Players Committee deck sheets) into this page. Every sheet reads "Ray Bordier": handwritten at the 2007 MPC, 2007 NY/NJ/PA States, 2009 2K Event, 2010–2012 MPC; typed "Ray Bordier" at the 2008 MPC; the 2009–2012 sheets add username Spectre. "Roy" was a transcription misreading. Forum posts also say Ray Bordier (2017 MPC registered players, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1082344#p1082344 p1082344]; old Decipher rankings, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1139533#p1139533 p1139533], Coruscant region). Deck pages and scans moved from "Roy Bordier" titles. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 21:22, 31 October 2026 (UTC)

== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 03:41, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
